value.title: Mutation-test from a git archive, not the review worktree

sections.name: body
sections.value:
From pij-printed-stork (#339). The review worktree is read-only (C25), so to run mutants without editing it: `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$(mktemp -d)"`, apply the mutant there, and build with `PIJ_SHARED_TARGET=<main checkout>/target just shared-build -- test ...` (one target per checkout, F217; nice 19 via the recipe). Delete the temp dir afterwards (F262).
Note: the memory verb is `pij directory memory add <role> --project pij-fleet ...`. Plain `pij memory` returns E-RS-UNPORTED.
